name: Ayane Midorikawa
source:
Pilot of the Lace Dragoon.

An outgoing and laid back hyena, entirely unsuited to the duties of a pilot. Has been a pilot for the Lilac for a decent amount of time, but holds her position in open disdain, and has little interest in discussing work. Has an honest and sometimes abrasive personality, but generally tries to be nice. Keeps her circumstances to herself, but will lend an ear to others. Likes to play around and do as little as possible. Cool older sister of the team.

Sign: Leo
Favourite Food: Anything spicy.
Hobbies: Photography, Music.
Likes: Junk food, Cigarettes, People who give her things.
Dislikes: Boredom.

[From [url=https://coquettedragoon.com/cast/]official website[/url]]
